BARREL Balloon 1T XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; includes 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV bands plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV, payload 1T of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL Balloon 1H XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 1H of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV, plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra from 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1A MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated TCM2 three-axis magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution, used to identify substorm signatures and ultra-low-frequency oscillations during the first Antarctic BARREL campaign in 2012–2013

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1I MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated TCM2 three-axis magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution, used to identify substorms and ULF oscillations; payload 1I of the BARREL second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014)
Geotail EFD electric field detector measuring three-component DC and low-frequency electric field vectors in the Earth's magnetotail and magnetopause regions

BARREL Balloon 2A XRI (X-ray Instrument) sodium iodide scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and energy spectra from radiation-belt electron precipitation over 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2A of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms count rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV bands plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra from 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 1R MAG (Magnetometer) three-axis tilt-compensated PNI TCM2-20 magnetometer measuring local vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution, plus pitch/roll attitude for horizontal/vertical field separation; payload 1R of the BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), used to identify substorms and ultra-low-frequency oscillations associated with precipitation

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1G MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis PNI TCM2 magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at ~1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution, used to identify substorm activity and ULF magnetic oscillations; payload 1G of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1V XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring precipitating-electron bremsstrahlung X-ray flux/spectra, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 1V, first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV bands and 20 keV-7 MeV spectra.

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1Q MAG (Magnetometer) three-axis PNI TCM2 tilt-compensated magneto-inductive magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for substorm and ULF-wave context; payload 1Q of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign, 2013–2014

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2B DPU (Data Processing Unit) data-system platform acquiring X-ray spectrometer counts, magnetometer vectors, GPS (Global Positioning System) position/time, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping; payload 2B of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014), formatting frames for Iridium downlink and command cutdown.

BARREL Balloon 1D MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field perturbations (three components, ~10–50 nT resolution, 1 s cadence) to identify substorms and ultra-low-frequency oscillations associated with precipitation; payload 1D of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) first Antarctic campaign, 2012–2013

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1B MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local geomagnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution, using the TCM2 sensor for substorm and ultralow-frequency magnetic pulsation context during the first Antarctic BARREL campaign in 2012–2013.

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1R XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 1R of the first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 50 ms bands 10-180, 180-550, 550-840 and 840-1500 keV plus spectra to 7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 1Q XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; response ~10 keV-10 MeV, 50 ms bands 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV, plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV; payload 1Q of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL Balloon 1A XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 1A of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840 and 840-1500 keV bands, plus 48/256-channel spectra from 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 1O MAG (magnetometer) three-axis tilt-compensated magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic field perturbations at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for substorm and ULF wave context; the PNI TCM2/TCM2-20 sensor on payload 1O of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1M MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated PNI TCM2-20 three-axis magnetometer measuring local vector geomagnetic field perturbations for substorm and ultra-low-frequency wave context, with 1 s samples and ~10 nT resolution; payload 1M of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014)

BARREL Balloon 1J MAG (Magnetometer) TCM2-20 tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local geomagnetic field components at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for identifying substorm activity and ULF magnetic oscillations; payload 1J of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1U MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis PNI TCM2-20 magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field perturbations at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for substorm and ultralow-frequency wave context; payload 1U of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014)

ACE SWEPAM (Solar Wind Electron, Proton, and Alpha Monitor) dual electrostatic analyzer suite measuring 3-D solar wind electron distributions from 1-900 eV and proton/alpha ion distributions from 0.26-35 keV, providing plasma bulk speed, density, temperature, alpha/proton parameters, and electron heat-flux or pitch-angle distributions with separate electron and ion analyzers.

BARREL Balloon 1C XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 1C of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV bands, plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra from 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1S MAG (magnetometer), a TCM2 tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local vector magnetic-field perturbations at ~1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution for substorm and ULF wave context; payload 1S of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL Balloon 1M XRI (X-ray instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 1M of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013), with 50 ms bands 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV plus 48-channel/4 s and 256-channel/32 s spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2B XRI (X-ray Instrument), a NaI scintillator X-ray spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 2B of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), response 10 keV-10 MeV, with 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV bands and spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 1V MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local geomagnetic field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for identifying substorms and ULF magnetic oscillations; TCM2 sensor on payload 1V of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013–2014), conjugate with the Van Allen Probes

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1D XRI (X-ray Instrument) sodium iodide scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 1D of the first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV bands, plus 4 s 48-channel and 32 s 256-channel spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2A MAG (magnetometer), a TCM2 tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field perturbations at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for substorm and ultra-low-frequency wave context; payload 2A of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign, 2013-2014

BARREL Balloon 1I XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator energetic-particle/X-ray spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 1I of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840 and 840-1500 keV bands, and 20 keV-7 MeV spectra in 48 or 256 channels
BARREL 3F data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight
BARREL 4C ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight

BARREL Balloon 1Q EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform product measuring time-tagged balloon trajectory positions—latitude, longitude, altitude and derived coordinates in multiple geophysical systems—for payload 1Q of the Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Relativistic Electron Losses first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)

FOXSI-2 (flight 2, 2014-12-11) Focusing Optics X-ray Solar Imager sounding-rocket focusing hard X-ray solar telescope imaging solar coronal, flare, and active-region X-ray emission, spectra, and source morphology with improved sensitivity, using grazing-incidence focusing optics and pixelated semiconductor detectors over roughly 4–20 keV.

instruments.instrument_name: In-situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients
instruments.description: STEREO-A IMPACT (In-situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients) in-situ particle/field and CME-transient suite measuring interplanetary/solar-wind magnetic fields, solar-wind electrons, suprathermal electrons/ions, and solar energetic particles from eV plasma to >100 MeV ions; with MAG (magnetometer), SWEA (Solar Wind Electron Analyzer), STE (Suprathermal Electron Telescope), SEPT (Solar Electron Proton Telescope), SIT (Suprathermal Ion Telescope), LET (Low Energy Telescope), HET (High Energy Telescope)

Sunrise Balloon Flight #1 (June 9-13, 2009) SUNRISE-1 IMaX (Imaging Magnetograph eXperiment) Fabry-Perot imaging spectropolarimeter and vector magnetograph measuring solar photospheric vector magnetic fields, Doppler/line-of-sight velocities, continuum intensity, and Stokes I,Q,U,V profiles in the Fe I 525.02 nm (5250.2 Å) spectral line during the June 2009 Arctic balloon campaign.

Sunrise Balloon Flight #1 (June 9-13, 2009) / SUNRISE-1 SuFI (Sunrise Filter Imager) ultraviolet/blue filtergraph on the 1-m Sunrise solar telescope measuring high-resolution solar photospheric and chromospheric/low-chromospheric intensity structure in five UV passbands between 214 and 397 nm, near 214, 300, 312 nm OH, 388 nm CN, and 397 nm Ca II H, complementing IMaX vector-magnetograph observations

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1R DPU (Data Processing Unit) platform controller acquiring and framing data from the X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS (Global Positioning System), and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) for payload 1R of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1C DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data-handling platform for the 2012-2013 Antarctic campaign, not a science sensor; acquired and framed X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS (Global Positioning System), and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) data for Iridium downlink and cutdown commanding.

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1T MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for substorm and ultra-low-frequency oscillation context; TCM2 sensor on payload 1T of the first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1D EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform product providing payload trajectory positions for unit 1D of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013), with balloon location reported in multiple coordinate systems for conjunction and context studies

BARREL Balloon 1J EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform instrument measuring payload trajectory positions for Balloon 1J of the first BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Antarctic campaign in 2012-2013, providing time-tagged latitude, longitude, altitude, and derived positions in multiple geophysical coordinate systems

MinXSS-1 X123 SXR (soft X-ray) spectrometer, an Amptek silicon-drift X-ray spectrometer measuring disk-integrated solar soft X-ray spectral irradiance from ~0.5-30 keV with ~0.15 keV resolution, the primary science sensor on Miniature X-Ray Solar Spectrometer CubeSat 1 alongside the XP X-ray photometer and SPS solar position sensor

GOES-12 (2003–2010) (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 12) SXI (Solar X-ray Imager) soft X-ray telescope providing full-disk solar coronal brightness images and flare/active-region morphology measurements in broadband 0.6–6 nm soft X-rays; GOES-M series unit launched in 2001 and used for NOAA solar monitoring in the 2000s alongside standard GOES XRS irradiance sensors

instruments.instrument_name: Shortwave EUV observation of Sun with EUNIS (2007 flight)
instruments.description: EUNIS-2007 SW (Extreme Ultraviolet Normal-Incidence Spectrograph short-wavelength) solar normal-incidence EUV imaging spectrograph channel measuring spatially resolved transition-region and coronal emission-line spectra over ~170-205 Å; the 2007 sounding-rocket flight channel of EUNIS alongside its LW long-wavelength channel (~300-370 Å)

instruments.instrument_name: Shortwave EUV observation of Sun with EUNIS (trimmed/2007 flight)
instruments.description: EUNIS-07 EUNIS (Extreme Ultraviolet Normal Incidence Spectrograph) short-wavelength EUV normal-incidence sounding-rocket spectrograph measuring solar transition-region and coronal emission-line spectra, radiances, Doppler shifts, and morphology in the ~170-205 Å band during the 2007 EUNIS solar calibration flight, complementary to its long-wavelength channel.

BARREL 3A ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight

LANL Spacecraft Series LANL-2001 (2001–2008) MPA (Magnetospheric Plasma Analyzer) electrostatic analyzer measuring 3-D ion and electron energy-per-charge distributions from ~1 eV/q to >40 keV/q at geosynchronous orbit; spin-scanned plasma spectra, moments, and pitch-angle/azimuthal coverage for magnetospheric studies.

Evans spectroheliograph solar imaging spectrograph measuring full-disk solar chromospheric intensity in narrow spectral-line passbands, chiefly H-alpha 656.3 nm and Ca II K 393.4 nm spectroheliograms, used for optical patrol of active regions, plages, filaments, flares, and other line-emission/absorption morphology at the Evans Solar Facility

FOXSI-3 FOXSI (Focusing Optics X-ray Solar Imager) sounding-rocket grazing-incidence focusing X-ray telescope measuring solar soft/hard X-ray imaging spectroscopy, chiefly ~4–20 keV photons from active regions, microflares, and quiet-Sun sources; flight #3 launched 2018-09-07 with Wolter-I optics and pixellated semiconductor focal-plane detectors.

instruments.instrument_name: PHOENIX detector on flight #3 of FOXSI
instruments.description: Focusing Optics X-ray Solar Imager flight #3 PHOENIX (PHoton-counting Energy-resolving Imager for X-rays) photon-counting CMOS focal-plane X-ray imaging spectrometer measuring focused solar X-ray images and spectra (~0.5–10 keV) on the FOXSI-3 sounding-rocket flight of 2018-09-07, complementing the CdTe strip-detector telescopes.

GONG (Global Oscillations Network Group) Big Bear ground-based helioseismic imaging spectrometer/telescope measuring full-disk solar photospheric line-of-sight Doppler velocity, line-of-sight magnetic field, and continuum intensity in the Ni I 676.8 nm line; the Big Bear Solar Observatory, California node used with other GONG stations for near-continuous p-mode and synoptic magnetogram observations

GONG (Global Oscillation Network Group) Cerro Tololo ground-based solar telescope station measuring full-disk photospheric Doppler velocity, line-of-sight magnetic field, and continuum intensity in the Ni I 676.8 nm line for helioseismology and solar activity monitoring; Chilean network unit at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory alongside the other GONG sites

GONG (Global Oscillations Network Group) El Teide full-disk solar Doppler imager at Observatorio del Teide, Tenerife, measuring photospheric line-of-sight velocity, continuum/intensity, and line-of-sight magnetic field in the Ni I 6768 Å line for helioseismology, one of the six GONG network stations alongside Big Bear, Mauna Loa, Learmonth, Udaipur, and Cerro Tololo

GONG (Global Oscillations Network Group) Learmonth ground-based full-disk solar Doppler imager and magnetograph at Learmonth Solar Observatory, Western Australia, measuring photospheric line-of-sight velocity, continuum intensity, and line-of-sight magnetic field in the Ni I 676.8 nm line for helioseismology and solar activity monitoring, one of the six GONG network sites.

Global Oscillations Network Group MERGED GONG (Global Oscillations Network Group) ground-based helioseismic imaging network measuring full-disk solar line-of-sight Doppler velocity, magnetic field, and continuum intensity in the Ni I 676.8 nm line; merged products combine six-site GONG observations into near-continuous Dopplergrams and magnetograms

Global Oscillations Network Group Mauna Loa Observatory (MLO) ground-based solar helioseismology station measuring full-disk photospheric Doppler velocity, line-of-sight magnetic field, and continuum intensity in the Ni I 676.8 nm line; one of the GONG network units alongside Big Bear, Learmonth, Udaipur, El Teide, and Cerro Tololo

GONG (Global Oscillation Network Group) Udaipur station ground-based full-disk solar Doppler/magnetograph instrument measuring photospheric line-of-sight velocity, continuum intensity, and line-of-sight magnetic field in the Ni I 676.8 nm line for helioseismology and synoptic solar monitoring, one of the six GONG network sites alongside Big Bear, Mauna Loa, Learmonth, El Teide, and Cerro Tololo

UCAR HAO Historical Eclipse Archive (University Corporation for Atmospheric Research High Altitude Observatory Historical Eclipse Archive) ground-based solar eclipse image archive measuring visible white-light coronal brightness, morphology, and polarization from digitized total-solar-eclipse photographs and expedition records, used for historical corona, streamer, and solar-cycle studies
BARREL 1N X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)
BARREL 4E X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)
BARREL 4F X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)
BARREL 3A X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) MAG (Magnetic Field Instrument) dual triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring the three-component interplanetary magnetic field; two boom-mounted sensors, M1 and M2, provide vector fields over ±0.004 to ±65536 nT, with standard averaged vectors, 30 vectors/s snapshot data, and Fast Fourier Transform spectral products for magnetic-field fluctuations.

Hi-C Hi-C (High Resolution Coronal Imager) EUV sounding-rocket telescope measuring fine-scale solar coronal structure and dynamics in a narrow 193 Å (19.3 nm) Fe XII/XXIV bandpass, the original Hi-C flight payload from the 2012 campaign, cited in papers as Hi-C or Hi-C 1 with sub-arcsecond EUV imaging of active-region corona

Hi-C21 Hi-C 2.1 (High Resolution Coronal Imager 2.1) extreme-ultraviolet sounding-rocket telescope measuring high-resolution solar coronal images in the 172 Å Fe IX/X passband (~0.8 MK); 2018 White Sands flight observing sub-arcsecond active-region loops, moss, and fine-scale EUV structure, often compared with SDO/AIA 171 Å data

Hinode SOT (Solar Optical Telescope) diffraction-limited visible solar telescope measuring photospheric and chromospheric intensity, Doppler velocity, and vector magnetic fields; comprising the FG (Filtergraph) with BFI (Broadband Filter Imager) and NFI (Narrowband Filter Imager), plus SP (Spectro-Polarimeter) full-Stokes scans of the Fe I 630.15/630.25 nm lines

Hinode XRT (X-Ray Telescope) grazing-incidence soft-X-ray/Extreme Ultraviolet imager measuring solar coronal emission, morphology, and temperature structure from ≲1 to >10 MK, using broadband analysis filters including Al-mesh, Al-poly, C-poly, Ti-poly, Be-thin, Be-med, Al-med, Al-thick, and Be-thick, plus visible-light/G-band context imaging

Improved Solar Observing Optical Network ISOON (Improved Solar Observing Optical Network) ground-based full-disk solar patrol telescope measuring chromospheric H-alpha 656.28 nm line-center and wing filtergrams (commonly ±0.4 and ±0.8 Å), derived Dopplergrams, photospheric continuum/white-light sunspot imagery, and longitudinal magnetic-field products for flare, filament, and active-region monitoring

Kitt Peak Vacuum Tower Telescope (KPVT) 512-channel magnetograph ground-based solar diode-array spectromagnetograph measuring full-disk photospheric line-of-sight magnetic flux density and Doppler velocity in Fe I 8688 Å, with continuum intensity and He I 10830 Å equivalent-width synoptic maps used for coronal-hole and large-scale solar-field studies

Kitt Peak Vacuum Tower Telescope SPMG (Spectromagnetograph) solar scanning spectropolarimeter measuring full-disk photospheric line-of-sight magnetic field, Doppler velocity, and continuum/line intensity, chiefly in Fe I 868.8 nm, with synoptic chromospheric/coronal-hole context from He I 1083.0 nm and Ca II 854.2 nm spectral observations

instruments.mission_name: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory, Karl-Franzens-Universität, Graz, Austria
instruments.description: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory Ca II K (singly ionized calcium K line) narrowband solar imager measuring full-disk chromospheric intensity at 393.37 nm, used for synoptic observations of plages, active-region evolution, flare brightenings, network emission, and solar disk context alongside Kanzelhöhe H-alpha and white-light patrol data.

instruments.mission_name: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory, Karl-Franzens-Universität, Graz, Austria
instruments.description: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory Hα Film Camera (hydrogen-alpha film camera) full-disk solar patrol imager measuring chromospheric Hα 656.3 nm intensity and morphology of flares, filaments, prominences, plage, and active regions on photographic film, the historical Kanzelhöhe H-alpha synoptic record from Karl-Franzens-Universität Graz.

instruments.mission_name: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory, Karl-Franzens-Universität, Graz, Austria
instruments.description: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory Hα Patrol Instrument (hydrogen-alpha patrol instrument) full-disk narrowband solar chromospheric imager measuring Hα 656.28 nm line-center intensity, typically with ~0.07 nm passband, for high-cadence patrol of flares, filaments, prominences, plages, active regions, and Moreton/EUV-wave chromospheric signatures, commonly cited as KSO Hα filtergrams

instruments.instrument_name: Mees Solar Observatory Imaging Spectrograph on Haleakala, Maui
instruments.description: Mees CCD Imaging Spectrograph (charge-coupled-device imaging spectrograph) ground-based solar optical spectrograph at Mees Solar Observatory on Haleakala, Maui, measuring spatially resolved solar spectra, line profiles, continuum intensity, and Doppler/line-shape diagnostics of active regions, flares, sunspots, and prominences, commonly in chromospheric lines such as H-alpha 656.3 nm.

Mauna Loa Solar Observatory K-Cor (K-Coronagraph) white-light coronagraph measuring linearly polarized K-coronal brightness and derived coronal electron density in the low corona, with full-limb imaging from about 1.05 to 3 solar radii in a red/near-infrared continuum band near 735 nm, widely used for CME and streamer observations.

Mauna Loa Solar Observatory CHP (Chromospheric Helium-I Photometer) solar photometer measuring full-disk and synoptic chromospheric He I 10830 Å absorption/emission, used to track coronal holes, active regions, filaments, prominences, and solar-wind source regions; predecessor/companion context for MLSO He I imaging later cited as CHIP data

Mauna Loa Solar Observatory DPM (Digital Prominence Monitor) H-alpha imaging prominence monitor measuring solar limb and low-coronal chromospheric emission from prominences, filaments, surges, and eruptions in the 656.3 nm line, providing full-disk/limb context images and synoptic prominence morphology for coronal mass ejection studies

McMath FTS (Fourier Transform Spectrometer) ground-based solar spectrometer measuring high-resolution solar irradiance/intensity spectra, continuum levels, and photospheric/chromospheric line profiles from the visible through infrared, commonly cited as the McMath-Pierce or Kitt Peak solar FTS, with coverage of roughly 0.3–30 µm (≈33,000–330 cm⁻¹).

MtWilson 60-ft SHG (Spectroheliograph) ground-based solar spectroheliograph measuring full-disk solar chromospheric intensity and activity morphology, chiefly in the Ca II K line at 393.37 nm and also H-alpha 656.28 nm, producing Mt. Wilson 60-foot tower spectroheliograms used for plage, faculae, network, sunspot, and solar-cycle studies

instruments.mission_name: Osservatorio Astrofisico di Catania, Via S.Sofia 78, 95123 Catania ITALY
instruments.description: Osservatorio Astrofisico di Catania BE-Continuum (Barra Equatoriale Continuum) ground-based solar continuum imager measuring full-disk photospheric white-light intensity near 607 nm, sunspots, pores, and active-region morphology; continuum channel of the Barra Equatoriale suite alongside BE-Halpha and BE-CaIIK.

Solar Orbiter EUI (Extreme Ultraviolet Imager) imaging telescope suite measuring high-cadence solar EUV/UV radiance and morphology of the chromosphere, transition region, and corona; comprising FSI (Full Sun Imager, 17.4 and 30.4 nm), HRI_EUV (High Resolution Imager EUV, 17.4 nm), and HRI_Lyα (High Resolution Imager Lyman-alpha, 121.6 nm)

instruments.instrument_name: Comprehensive Suprathermal and Energetic Particle Analyzer
instruments.description: Solar and Heliospheric Observatory (SOHO) COSTEP (Comprehensive Suprathermal and Energetic Particle Analyzer) energetic-particle telescope suite measuring suprathermal and solar energetic electrons, protons, helium, and heavier ions in the heliosphere from ~44 keV/nucleon to >50 MeV/nucleon; comprising LION (Low-energy Ion and Electron Instrument) and EPHIN (Electron Proton Helium Instrument) sensors

Pic-du-Midi CLIMSO (Christian Latouche IMageur SOlaire) ground-based solar imaging suite measuring full-disk chromospheric emission and off-limb prominences/low corona; comprising L1 H-alpha 656.28 nm full-disk telescope, L2 Ca II K 393.37 nm full-disk telescope, C1 H-alpha coronagraph, and C2 He I 1083.0 nm coronagraph.

PROBA-2 LYRA (Large Yield RAdiometer) broadband solar ultraviolet/extreme-ultraviolet radiometer measuring rapid solar irradiance variations and flares in four channels: Lyman-alpha 120-123 nm, Herzberg continuum 190-222 nm, Aluminum 17-80 nm plus soft X-rays <5 nm, and Zirconium 6-20 nm plus soft X-rays <2 nm

instruments.instrument_name: Sun Watcher using Active pixel system detector and image Processing
instruments.description: PROBA2 SWAP (Sun Watcher using Active Pixel System detector and Image Processing) extreme-ultraviolet solar telescope/imager measuring full-disk and off-limb coronal emission in the 17.4 nm (174 Å, Fe IX/X, ~1 MK) band, used for solar rotation, active regions, eruptions, dimmings, coronal waves, and space-weather context imaging

instruments.instrument_name: Wide-Field Imager for Solar Probe Plus
instruments.description: Parker Solar Probe WISPR (Wide-Field Imager for Solar Probe) white-light coronagraph/heliospheric imager measuring Thomson-scattered visible emission from the K-corona, solar wind, CMEs, streamers, jets, and dust; comprising the WISPR-I inner telescope and WISPR-O outer telescope, spanning ~13.5°-108° solar elongation in a ~490-740 nm band

instruments.instrument_name: Reuven Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager
instruments.mission_name: Reuven Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager
instruments.description: Reuven Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager RHESSI (Reuven Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager) rotating-collimator high-purity germanium imaging spectrometer measuring solar-flare hard X-ray and gamma-ray photons, spectra, images, light curves, continua, and nuclear lines from ~3 keV to ~17 MeV; also cited prelaunch as HESSI (High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager)

Solar Dynamics Observatory AIA (Atmospheric Imaging Assembly) EUV/UV/visible full-disk imaging telescope suite measuring solar atmospheric emission and variability in the corona, transition region, chromosphere, and photosphere; standard channels are 94, 131, 171, 193, 211, 304, and 335 Å EUV, 1600 and 1700 Å UV, and 4500 Å white light.

Solar Dynamics Observatory EVE (Extreme Ultraviolet Variability Experiment) irradiance spectrograph suite measuring full-disk solar soft X-ray, extreme-ultraviolet, and Lyman-alpha spectral irradiance; comprising ESP (EUV SpectroPhotometer), MEGS-A and MEGS-B (Multiple EUV Grating Spectrographs, ~5-37 and 35-105 nm), and MEGS-P photometer at 121.6 nm.

Solar Dynamics Observatory HMI (Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager) full-disk tunable filtergraph measuring photospheric Doppler velocity, continuum intensity, line-of-sight magnetic field, and vector magnetic field from polarized filtergrams in the Fe I 6173 Å line for helioseismology and solar magnetic-field studies.

Solar Flare Telescope SFT (Solar Flare Telescope) T1 Hα (hydrogen-alpha) full-disk narrowband imaging telescope measuring chromospheric solar activity in the 656.28 nm Hα line, recording full-Sun images of flares, filaments, prominences, plages, and active regions; the T1 full-disk sensor of the SFT suite alongside its higher-resolution flare and magnetic-field telescopes
BARREL 3E ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 4B ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 4A X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

Solar Maximum Mission CP (Coronagraph/Polarimeter) white-light externally occulted coronagraph and polarimeter measuring total and polarized K-coronal brightness, coronal electron density structure, streamers, and coronal mass ejections in the visible corona, chiefly over ~1.5–6 solar radii from Sun center

Solar Orbiter SoloHI (Solar Orbiter Heliospheric Imager) white-light heliospheric imager measuring Thomson-scattered visible sunlight (~500–850 nm) from solar-wind electrons and dust, imaging coronal mass ejections, shocks, streamers, co-rotating interaction regions, and other density structures over ~5°–45° solar elongation.

SOHO CDS (Coronal Diagnostic Spectrometer) extreme-ultraviolet spectrometer measuring coronal and transition-region emission-line intensities, Doppler shifts, electron temperatures, densities, and abundances; comprising NIS (Normal Incidence Spectrometer) channels at 308-381 Å and 513-633 Å and GIS (Grazing Incidence Spectrometer) bands spanning about 151-785 Å

SOHO EIT (Extreme ultraviolet Imaging Telescope) normal-incidence EUV imager measuring full-disk solar transition-region and coronal emission in four narrow passbands: 171 Å (Fe IX/X), 195 Å (Fe XII), 284 Å (Fe XV), and 304 Å (He II), used for coronal holes, active regions, CMEs, EUV waves, and solar irradiance context

instruments.instrument_name: Energetic and Relativistic Nuclei and Electron experiment
instruments.description: SOHO ERNE (Energetic and Relativistic Nuclei and Electron experiment) energetic-particle telescope measuring solar energetic electrons, protons, alpha particles, and heavy ions from H to Fe at ~1–500 MeV/nucleon and electrons to ~10 MeV; comprising LED (Low Energy Detector) and HED (High Energy Detector) sensors, often cited as ERNE/LED and ERNE/HED.

SOHO GOLF (Global Oscillations at Low Frequencies) resonant-scattering spectrophotometer measuring Sun-as-a-star line-of-sight Doppler velocity and intensity fluctuations in the sodium D1/D2 Fraunhofer lines (589.6 and 589.0 nm), used for low-degree helioseismic p modes and candidate low-frequency g modes over roughly 10^-7-10^-2 Hz

SOHO (Solar and Heliospheric Observatory) LASCO (Large Angle and Spectrometric Coronagraph) coronagraph suite measuring white-light and emission-line solar corona, CMEs, streamers, and coronal electron density; comprising C1 spectrometric coronagraph (1.1-3 R☉), C2 white-light coronagraph (1.5-6 R☉), and C3 wide-field white-light coronagraph (3.7-30 R☉)

Solar and Heliospheric Observatory MDI (Michelson Doppler Imager) tunable Michelson filtergraph measuring solar photospheric Doppler velocity, continuum intensity, and line-of-sight magnetic field from the Ni I 6768 Å absorption line, providing full-disk and high-resolution Dopplergrams, magnetograms, and intensity images for helioseismology and photospheric field studies

instruments.instrument_name: Solar Ultraviolet Measurements of Emitted Radiation
instruments.description: SOHO SUMER (Solar Ultraviolet Measurements of Emitted Radiation) normal-incidence ultraviolet spectrometer measuring high-resolution solar extreme-ultraviolet and far-ultraviolet emission-line spectra, radiances, Doppler shifts, and line widths over ~465-1610 Å for chromospheric, transition-region, and coronal plasma diagnostics

Solar and Heliospheric Observatory SWAN (Solar Wind Anisotropies) ultraviolet all-sky photometer/imager measuring interplanetary H I Lyman-alpha 121.6 nm glow to infer solar-wind proton flux, ionization-rate anisotropies and heliospheric neutral-hydrogen structure; comprising the SU+Z and SU-Z sensor units viewing opposite hemispheres

instruments.mission_name: Synoptic Optical Long-term Investigations of the Sun
instruments.description: SOLIS (Synoptic Optical Long-term Investigations of the Sun) ISS (Integrated Sunlight Spectrometer) high-resolution Sun-as-a-star spectrograph measuring disk-integrated solar spectral irradiance and line profiles from ~350-1100 nm, including Ca II K 393.4 nm, Mn I 539.5 nm, Hα 656.3 nm, and He I 1083.0 nm activity diagnostics

instruments.instrument_name: Sun Earth Connection Coronal and Heliospheric Investigation
instruments.description: STEREO-B SECCHI (Sun Earth Connection Coronal and Heliospheric Investigation) remote-sensing imager suite measuring EUV solar-disk/coronal emission and white-light corona, CMEs, and heliospheric density structures; comprising EUVI (Extreme Ultraviolet Imager; 171, 195, 284, 304 Å), COR1 (inner coronagraph), COR2 (outer coronagraph), and HI-1/HI-2 (Heliospheric Imagers) from ~1.4 solar radii to large elongations.

STEREO-B WAVES (Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory/WAVES) radio and plasma wave suite measuring interplanetary electric-field spectra and waveforms, type II/III solar radio bursts, and plasma-frequency density; comprising LFR (Low Frequency Receiver, ~2.5-160 kHz), HFR (High Frequency Receiver, ~125 kHz-16 MHz), and TDS (Time Domain Sampler) fed by three electric monopole antennas

Sunrise Balloon Flight #2 IMaX (Imaging Magnetograph eXperiment) Fabry-Pérot imaging spectropolarimeter measuring solar photospheric Stokes I,Q,U,V profiles in the Fe I 525.02 nm (5250.2 Å) line and nearby continuum to derive vector magnetic fields, line-of-sight velocities, and continuum intensity during the June 12-17, 2013 Sunrise II balloon campaign

instruments.instrument_name: BARREL Balloon 3G Tilt Compensated Magnetometer, TCM2, Instrument
instruments.description: BARREL 3G tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local magnetic field variations and ULF wave activity during stratospheric balloon flight

instruments.instrument_name: BARREL Balloon 3F Tilt Compensated Magnetometer, TCM2, Instrument
instruments.description: BARREL 3F tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local magnetic field variations and ULF wave activity during stratospheric balloon flight

ACE SIS (Solar Isotope Spectrometer) particle telescope measuring isotopic composition, elemental abundances, and energy spectra of energetic ions from He through Zn (Z=2-30) at ~10-100 MeV/nucleon, covering solar energetic particles from flares and shocks, anomalous cosmic rays, and lower-energy galactic cosmic rays below the CRIS range

Sunrise Balloon Flight #2 SuFI (Sunrise Filter Imager) ultraviolet/visible solar filter imager measuring high-resolution photospheric and low-chromospheric intensity structure in narrow bands near 214, 300, 312, 388 nm CN, and 397 nm Ca II H; flown on the second Sunrise long-duration balloon campaign, 12-17 June 2013, alongside IMaX.

instruments.instrument_name: Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope (1999 flight)
instruments.mission_name: Upgraded Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope (VAULT2.0)
instruments.description: VAULT2.0 VAULT (Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope) sounding-rocket ultraviolet solar telescope, 1999 flight, imaging solar H I Ly-alpha 1216 Å emission at sub-arcsecond angular resolution to measure chromospheric/transition-region fine structure, plage, network, and active-region morphology

instruments.instrument_name: Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope (2014 flight)
instruments.mission_name: Upgraded Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope (VAULT2.0)
instruments.description: VAULT2.0 (Upgraded Very High Angular Resolution Ultraviolet Telescope) sounding-rocket solar ultraviolet telescope measuring high-angular-resolution narrowband H I Ly-alpha 1216 Å emission from the upper chromosphere and transition region; 2014 flight of the VAULT payload series, used for subarcsecond solar Ly-alpha imaging of active-region and quiet-Sun fine structure

Yohkoh BCS (Bragg Crystal Spectrometer) bent-crystal soft X-ray spectrometer measuring full-Sun solar-flare line spectra, intensities, Doppler shifts, and thermal/nonthermal broadening; four channels cover Fe XXVI 1.7636–1.8044 Å, Fe XXV 1.8298–1.8942 Å, Ca XIX 3.1631–3.1912 Å, and S XV 5.0160–5.1143 Å.

ACE ULEIS (Ultra-Low Energy Isotope Spectrometer) time-of-flight mass spectrometer measuring suprathermal and solar energetic ion elemental and isotopic composition from He through Ni at ~20 keV/nucleon to 10 MeV/nucleon, with ≤0.3 amu mass resolution and limited ultra-heavy ion measurements above Ni near ~0.5 MeV/nucleon.

ACE CRIS (Cosmic Ray Isotope Spectrometer) particle detector measuring elemental and isotopic composition, energy spectra, and trajectories of energetic nuclei; resolves galactic cosmic rays He–Zn (Z=2–30) at ~100–600 MeV/nucleon with ≤0.25 amu mass resolution, with exploratory ultra-heavy Ga–Zr (Z=31–40), using the SOFT hodoscope and silicon detector telescopes

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1O EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring time-tagged payload trajectory positions—latitude, longitude, altitude, and derived coordinates in multiple geophysical systems—for balloon 1O of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013)

Apollo 12 ALSEP (Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package) SWS (Solar Wind Spectrometer) seven-Faraday-cup spectrometer measuring directional fluxes and energy spectra of lunar-surface solar wind and magnetotail plasma, with positive ions/protons from 18-9780 eV in 14 steps and electrons from 6-1330 eV in 7 steps every 28.1 s over overlapping look directions in the lunar sky

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1T DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data-handling platform for the 2010 test-flight unit, acquiring and framing X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS position/time, and EDI engineering data rather than making an independent heliophysics measurement

BARREL Balloon 1I DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload avionics controller supporting X-ray, magnetic-field, GPS position, and engineering measurements; unit 1I of the Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), acquiring XRI spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and EDI data for telemetry and cutdown control

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2A DPU (Data Processing Unit) flight data-system platform supporting measurements of bremsstrahlung X-rays, magnetic field, GPS position/time, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping data on payload 2A of the second Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), formatting data for Iridium downlink and cutdown commanding

BARREL Balloon 1M DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data-handling subsystem acquiring and framing XRI (X-ray Instrument) spectrometer counts, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering-interface data for Iridium downlink; Balloon 1M unit of the first BARREL Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), not a standalone particle or field sensor

BARREL Balloon 1S EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform product providing balloon trajectory positions for payload 1S of the BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign, reporting time-tagged location in multiple coordinate systems for conjunction and mapping studies rather than X-ray or particle measurements
BARREL 3A data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight
BARREL 3E data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight

BARREL Balloon 1A DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data handling platform supporting bremsstrahlung X-ray and magnetic-field measurements; payload 1A of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), acquiring the X-ray instrument, magnetometer, Global Positioning System (GPS) module, and Engineering Data Interface (EDI) for Iridium telemetry and cutdown commanding

ACE (Advanced Composition Explorer) SWIMS (Solar Wind Ion Mass Spectrometer), one of the SWICS/SWIMS composition suite sensors alongside SWICS (Solar Wind Ion Composition Spectrometer), is a time-of-flight mass spectrometer measuring solar wind ion mass, energy, elemental and isotopic abundances, covering He at 200-1500 km/s and Fe at 200-500 km/s with <1% mass resolution and ultra-heavy ions (A>60).

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1V DPU (Data Processing Unit) platform controller, not a standalone science sensor, acquiring and packetizing 10 keV-10 MeV X-ray spectrometer data, magnetometer vectors, GPS (Global Positioning System) time/position, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping for payload 1V of the 2015-2016 Antarctic campaign

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1D DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload controller/data system supporting X-ray spectrometer and magnetometer measurements, acquiring X-ray, magnetic-field, GPS, and engineering-interface data for Iridium telemetry and cutdown control; payload 1D, first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1B EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product giving payload trajectory and position coordinates for unit 1B of the first Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), used to locate the X-ray balloon measurements in geographic and space-physics coordinate systems

Apollo 15 ALSEP (Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package) SWS (Solar Wind Spectrometer) Faraday-cup plasma spectrometer measuring directional electron and positive-ion fluxes at the lunar surface, using seven sky-viewing modulated cups to sample solar-wind and magnetotail plasma: electrons 6-1480 eV and ions 30-10400 eV every 28.1 s

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1R EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring the payload 1R trajectory for the first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), providing time-tagged balloon position in geographic and magnetic coordinates, altitude, L shell, and magnetic local time for conjunction and context studies

ACE (Advanced Composition Explorer) Ephemeris spacecraft ephemeris/position data product measuring the ACE spacecraft trajectory rather than particles or fields, providing location and velocity at the Sun-Earth L1 halo orbit in GSE/GSM and related coordinates for time tagging, conjunction checks, and solar-wind propagation studies

IRIS (Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph) ultraviolet slit spectrograph and slit-jaw imager measuring solar chromosphere and transition-region intensities, Doppler shifts, line widths, and images; records spectra in far-ultraviolet bands 1332-1358 and 1389-1407 Å and near-ultraviolet 2783-2834 Å, with slit-jaw channels at 1330, 1400, 2796, and 2832 Å

instruments.mission_name: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory, Karl-Franzens-Universität, Graz, Austria
instruments.description: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory PDC (Photosphere Digital Camera) ground-based full-disk solar white-light imager measuring photospheric continuum intensity and sunspot/active-region morphology, providing digital photosphere patrol images of the solar disk for flare, sunspot, and active-region context studies.

instruments.mission_name: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory, Karl-Franzens-Universität, Graz, Austria
instruments.description: Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory Hα (hydrogen-alpha) Pulnix TM-1001 Camera full-disk narrowband solar imager measuring chromospheric intensity and morphology in the Hα 656.28 nm line, used for patrol observations of flares, filaments, plages, prominences, surges, and other solar activity from Kanzelhöhe, Austria

instruments.instrument_name: Charge, Element, and Isotope Analysis System
instruments.description: Solar and Heliospheric Observatory CELIAS (Charge, Element, and Isotope Analysis System) time-of-flight mass spectrometer and extreme-ultraviolet monitor suite measuring solar-wind ion charge states, elemental and isotopic abundances, bulk speed, and suprathermal ions; comprising CTOF (charge time-of-flight), MTOF (mass time-of-flight, including PM Proton Monitor), STOF (suprathermal time-of-flight), and SEM (Solar EUV Monitor, 26-34 nm and 0.1-50 nm flux).

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1U DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data-system platform acquiring and packetizing XRI (X-Ray Instrument) spectra, magnetometer vectors, GPS (Global Positioning System) time/position, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping for Iridium downlink and cutdown control; payload 1U of the first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013)
BARREL 4F ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 4G ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 3D X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)
BARREL 4E ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 4B X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

BARREL Balloon 1G EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform product providing trajectory positions of payload 1G from the first BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), in geographic/geocentric and magnetic coordinate systems for conjunction studies

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1A EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring/providing payload trajectory positions in multiple coordinate systems for geolocation and magnetic-conjunction studies; unit 1A of the first Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), not the XRI science detector

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2C EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring/recording payload trajectory positions in multiple coordinate systems for unit 2C of the second Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), used to locate X-ray observations of radiation-belt electron precipitation

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1H DPU (Data Processing Unit) platform controller acquiring and framing XRI (X-ray instrument) spectra, magnetometer, GPS (Global Positioning System), and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping data for the Balloon 1H first Antarctic campaign (2012-2013), with Iridium downlink and cutdown-command control

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2A EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring payload trajectory positions—latitude, longitude, altitude, and derived magnetic coordinates such as L shell and magnetic local time—for unit 2A of the second Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), colocated with its XRI observations.

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1B XRI (X-ray Instrument) sodium iodide scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 1B of the first Antarctic BARREL campaign (2012-2013), with 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV plus 48/256-channel spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

instruments.mission_name: Synoptic Optical Long-term Investigations of the Sun
instruments.description: Synoptic Optical Long-term Investigations of the Sun VSM (Vector Spectromagnetograph) full-disk solar spectropolarimeter measuring photospheric vector and line-of-sight magnetic fields, Doppler velocity, and continuum/chromospheric diagnostics from Stokes profiles in Fe I 630.15/630.25 nm, Ca II 854.2 nm, and He I 1083.0 nm solar spectral lines.

TRACE (Transition Region and Coronal Explorer) normal-incidence EUV/UV solar imaging telescope measuring high-resolution solar transition-region and coronal emission, morphology, and dynamics in passbands including 171 Å, 195 Å, and 284 Å EUV, 1216 Å Ly-alpha, 1550 Å C IV/continuum, 1600 Å and 1700 Å UV continuum, and white light.

BARREL Balloon 1Q DPU (Data Processing Unit) data-handling platform acquiring and framing X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS (Global Positioning System) position/time, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping data for downlink; payload 1Q of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), not a standalone particle or field sensor

BARREL Balloon 1G DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload data-processing platform supporting measurements of radiation-belt electron precipitation via the X-ray spectrometer, plus magnetometer, GPS position/time, and engineering-interface data; unit 1G of the first BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2012-2013), formatting telemetry for Iridium downlink and cutdown commanding

BARREL Balloon 2P DPU (Data Processing Unit) payload controller and data system measuring no independent science quantity; it acquires and frames XRI (X-ray Instrument) spectrometer counts, magnetometer, GPS position/time, and EDI (Engineering Data Interface) housekeeping for Iridium downlink on payload 2P of the second BARREL Antarctic campaign (2013-2014)

Communication/Navigation Outage Forecasting System (C/NOFS) IVM (Ion Velocity Meter) thermal ion analyzer in the CINDI (Coupled Ion-Neutral Dynamics Investigation) suite measuring ion drift vector, ion temperature, density, and major ion composition; comprising IDM (Ion Drift Meter) and RPA (Retarding Potential Analyzer), alongside NWM (Neutral Wind Meter) on C/NOFS.
MMS-3 ASPOC active spacecraft potential control device emitting indium ion beams to reduce spacecraft charging and enable undisturbed plasma and electric field measurements
BARREL 4D X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2W EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform data product measuring payload trajectory positions, altitude, and time-tagged location in multiple geographic and geomagnetic coordinate systems for unit 2W of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014)

Cluster-Rumba EDI (Electron Drift Instrument) active electron-beam drift instrument measuring magnetospheric convection electric field, E×B drift, magnetic-field magnitude, and field gradients by emitting weak 0.5 and 1 keV test-electron beams and timing their one-gyration returns; the Rumba/FM5 unit of the Cluster EDI instruments flown on Rumba, Salsa, Samba, and Tango

Equator-S EDI (Electron Drift Instrument) electron-beam drift instrument measuring ambient electric fields, magnetic-field gradients, and magnetic-field magnitude by tracking weak <1 μA test-electron beams returning after one gyration; operated at 0.5 and 1.0 keV beam energies with typically ≤100 ms resolution in the equatorial magnetosphere

Cluster-Rumba CIS (Cluster Ion Spectrometry) energetic ion spectrometer suite measuring spin-resolution 3D ion velocity distributions, moments, and composition; comprising HIA (Hot Ion Analyzer), a high-dynamic-range ion electrostatic analyzer without mass separation (~5 eV/q-32 keV/q), and CODIF (Composition and Distribution Function analyzer), a time-of-flight mass-per-charge sensor for H+, He++, He+, O+ from spacecraft potential/~20 eV/q to 40 keV/q

Cluster-Rumba ASPOC (Active Spacecraft Potential Control) spacecraft-potential control instrument measuring and regulating spacecraft charging by emitting ~6 keV indium ion beams at currents below 50 µA; uses EFW or PEACE potential feedback to hold low positive potential for cold plasma and electric-field measurements and performs ion-current sweeps for charging calibration

Cluster-Tango WHISPER (Waves of HIgh frequency and Sounder for Probing of Electron density by Relaxation) active plasma sounder and passive high-frequency wave receiver in the Wave Experiment Consortium measuring total local electron density, including cold plasma, from ~0.2–80 cm^-3 via resonances and natural electric-field emissions/spectra over 4–80 kHz using the Electric Field and Wave double-sphere antennas

FAST TEAMS (Time-of-Flight Energy Angle Mass Spectrograph) mass spectrometer measuring auroral ion 3-D distribution functions, energy/charge, mass/charge, and arrival angles for H+, He++, He+, O+, O2+, NO+ and minor heavy ions from 1.2 eV/e to 12 keV/e; a 360°×8° time-of-flight electrostatic analyzer providing Survey Distribution, High Mass Distribution, Burst, Pole Channel, Monitor Rate, and PHA event data

Cluster-Tango ASPOC (Active Spacecraft Potential Control) spacecraft-potential control instrument measuring and regulating spacecraft potential by emitting a controlled ~6 keV indium ion beam (<50 µA), with feedback from EFW (Electric Field and Wave) or PEACE (Plasma Electron And Current Experiment) to lower positive charging and enable cold-plasma particle, electric-field, and spacecraft-charging studies

Geotail EPIC (Energetic Particles and Ion Composition) quadrispherical analyzer particle composition suite measuring suprathermal and energetic ion charge state, mass, energy and angular distributions plus energetic electrons; comprising STICS (Supra-Thermal Ion Composition Spectrometer, 10-230 keV/q ions) and ICS (Ion Composition Subsystem, <50 keV-3 MeV ions and >30 keV electrons)

Dynamics Explorer 2 FPI (Fabry-Perot Interferometer) high-resolution scanning airglow interferometer measuring thermospheric temperature, meridional wind, and metastable O/O+ emission intensities/densities from Doppler line profiles; observed O I 5577 and 6300 Å, O II 7320 Å, Na 5896 Å, and 5200 Å emissions in limb/horizon altitude scans below the DE-2 orbit

GOES-9 (1995–1998) GOES (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites) Ephemeris spacecraft-position platform data product giving geocentric/geographic location and orbital ephemeris for the GOES-9 geostationary weather satellite of the GOES-J/GOES-I–M series, launched in 1995 and identified in heliophysics data as GOES 9 Position.

Cluster-Samba ASPOC (Active Spacecraft Potential Control) spacecraft-potential control ion-emitter instrument measuring spacecraft potential and emitted ion current while reducing positive charging with ~6 keV indium ions up to ~50 µA, improving cold plasma and electric-field measurements by EFW (Electric Field and Wave) and PEACE (Plasma Electron and Current Experiment)

ACE EPAM (Electron, Proton, and Alpha Monitor) energetic particle telescope suite measuring solar energetic and interplanetary electron and ion intensities, spectra, anisotropies, and composition from ~30 keV electrons and ~50 keV ions to several MeV; comprising LEFS60/LEFS150 (Low Energy Foil Spectrometers), LEMS30/LEMS120 (Low Energy Magnetic Spectrometers), and CA60 (Composition Aperture)

Dynamics Explorer 1 MAG-A (Magnetic Field Observations A) triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring vector magnetic fields for magnetosphere-ionosphere-atmosphere coupling, field-aligned currents over the auroral oval and polar cap, and ultra-low-frequency waves; ±6.2e4 nT dynamic range, 25 Hz bandwidth, with ~1.5, 0.25, and 0.02 nT resolution ranges

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2X MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis PNI TCM2 magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for local substorm activity and ultra-low-frequency oscillations; payload 2X of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013–2014)
BARREL 2F ephemeris providing balloon trajectory positions and altitude in multiple coordinate systems during stratospheric flight
BARREL 3D data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight
BARREL 3B X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)
BARREL 3C X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2P XRI (X-ray instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV response; 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra from 20 keV-7 MeV; payload 2P of the BARREL-II Antarctic campaign (2013-2014)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2D XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons (10 keV-10 MeV); payload 2D of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840 and 840-1500 keV and 20 keV-7 MeV spectra

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2T XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra/flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons at 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2T, second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), providing 50 ms bands 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV and 48-channel/4 s, 256-channel/32 s spectra at 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2C MAG (magnetometer), a TCM2 (Tilt Compensated Magnetometer 2) three-axis magneto-inductive sensor measuring vector magnetic-field components at ~1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution for substorm and ultralow-frequency wave context during the second Antarctic BARREL campaign, 2013-2014

Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP) Series SESS/SSM-Boom (Space Environment Sensor Suite/Special Sensor Magnetometer-Boom), represented by DMSP F16 (2003–2020), triaxial fluxgate magnetometer for vector geomagnetic perturbations/fluctuations and field-aligned current signatures in low-Earth polar orbit; F16 Block 5D-3 launched 2003, with SESS SSJ/5 (Special Sensor J/5), SSIES (Ions, Electrons & Scintillation), SSUSI (Ultraviolet Spectrographic Imager), and SSULI (Ultraviolet Limb Imager).

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2E XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2E of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms rates in 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, 840-1500 keV and 20 keV-7 MeV spectra in 48 or 256 channels

Deep Space Climate Observatory (DSCOVR) Ephemeris virtual platform instrument providing spacecraft ephemeris, orbit, position, velocity, and attitude state information for locating DSCOVR observations near Sun-Earth L1 and supporting interpretation of its solar-wind and Earth-observing data products

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2I MAG (magnetometer) three-axis TCM2 tilt-compensated magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field perturbations at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for substorm and ULF wave context; payload 2I of the second Antarctic balloon campaign, 2013-2014, conjugate with the Van Allen Probes

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2N MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis PNI TCM2 magnetometer measuring vector magnetic field variations, ULF oscillations, and substorm signatures at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution; payload 2N of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014)
BARREL 3B data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight
BARREL 3F X-ray Instrument NaI(Tl) scintillator measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra from precipitating electrons during stratospheric balloon flight (~34 km altitude)

CLASP2 Slit-Jaw (Chromospheric LAyer SpectroPolarimeter 2 Slit-Jaw) ultraviolet context imager, the slit-jaw camera of the CLASP2 sounding-rocket spectropolarimeter alongside the Mg II h/k spectrograph, measuring solar chromospheric near-UV intensity images around 280 nm to locate the spectrograph slit and co-register Mg II polarization spectra with solar structure

BARREL Balloon 2K XRI (X-ray Instrument), NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons at 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2K of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV plus 48-channel 4 s and 256-channel 32 s spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2O MAG (magnetometer), a TCM2 (Tilt Compensated Magnetometer) three-axis magneto-inductive sensor on the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014), measuring vector magnetic field components at 1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution for substorm and ULF-wave context.

BARREL Balloon 2M MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution for substorm signatures and ULF oscillations; PNI TCM2-20 unit on payload 2M of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign (2013-2014)

GOES-10 (1998–2009) MAG (magnetometer), the GOES I-M/GOES-K triaxial fluxgate magnetometer at geostationary orbit, measuring three-axis vector geomagnetic field components (Hp, He, Hn) and field magnitude for space-weather monitoring; primary/redundant boom sensors, ±1000 nT range, ~0.03 nT sensitivity, ~0.512 s sampling; also cited as operating 1997–2009

GOES-12 (2003–2010) MAG (Magnetometer) triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring in-situ geomagnetic/vector magnetic field at geostationary/geosynchronous orbit for space-weather monitoring; GOES-M spacecraft of the GOES I-M generation, with primary or redundant boom-mounted sensor, ±1000 nT range, 0.512 s vector sampling, ~0.03 nT quantization, and ~1 nT accuracy.

GOES-8 (1995–2003) (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites 8, GOES-I/M generation) MAG (Magnetometer) triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring three-axis geosynchronous/geostationary geomagnetic-field vectors and magnitude for space-weather monitoring, with ±1000 nT range, ~0.03 nT digitization, ~1 nT accuracy, and 0.512 s per-axis sampling.

GOES-9 (1995–1998) MAG (Magnetometer) triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring the vector geomagnetic field at geostationary orbit for space-weather monitoring, a Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites I-M/GOES 8-12 generation unit launched in 1995, with three components sampled every 0.512 s, ±1000 nT range, ~0.03 nT digitization, ~1 nT accuracy, and 0.5 Hz low-pass response

DMSP Series SESS/SSM-Boom, including DMSP F17 (2006–2022) SSM-Boom (Defense Meteorological Satellite Program Flight 17 Special Sensor Magnetometer boom), a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer in the SESS package measuring vector geomagnetic field fluctuations and auroral/electrodynamic-current perturbations along the F17 polar-orbiting spacecraft track, launched in 2006

GOES-11 (2006–2011) MAG (Magnetometer) triaxial fluxgate magnetometer measuring the geomagnetic/geostationary vector magnetic field and magnetospheric variations in three components at geostationary orbit; GOES-L/Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites 11 of the GOES I-M series, launched 2000 and operated as GOES-West 2006–2011, with ±1000 nT range, ~0.03 nT digitization, ~1 nT accuracy, and 0.512 s vector cadence after 0.5 Hz filtering

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2W XRI (X-ray Instrument) sodium iodide scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; second Antarctic campaign payload 2W (2013-2014), with 50 ms 10-180/180-550/550-840/840-1500 keV rates and 48-/256-channel spectra, 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 2K MAG (magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetic-field instrument measuring vector geomagnetic perturbations at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for substorm and ULF wave context; payload 2K of the BARREL second Antarctic balloon campaign (2013–2014), carrying the PNI TCM2-20 sensor also cited as TCM2 or Tilt Compensated Magnetometer

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2I XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray flux and spectra from precipitating electrons; payload 2I of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms bands 10-180/180-550/550-840/840-1500 keV, and 48-channel 4 s or 256-channel 32 s spectra over 20 keV-7 MeV

BARREL Balloon 2W MAG (Magnetometer), a TCM2 (Tilt Compensated Magnetometer) three-axis magneto-inductive sensor measuring vector magnetic field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for local substorm and ULF-wave context; payload 2W of the BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign 2 (2013–2014)
BARREL 4H data processing unit controlling instrument operations and acquiring X-ray spectrometer, magnetometer, GPS, and engineering telemetry during stratospheric balloon flight

instruments.description: BARREL 1N tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring local magnetic field variations and ULF wave activity during stratospheric balloon flight

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2M XRI (X-ray Instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2M of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV plus 20 keV-7 MeV spectra

Dynamics Explorer 1 RIMS (Retarding Ion Mass Spectrometer) retarding potential analyser/mass spectrometer measuring low-energy ion energy spectra, mass-per-charge composition, and flow/spin distributions in the ionosphere, plasmasphere, and magnetosphere; three sensor heads viewed radial, +Z, and -Z directions, resolving ions below 50 eV over 1–40 amu/q

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2O XRI (X-ray instrument) NaI scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons, 10 keV-10 MeV; payload 2O of the second Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), with 50-ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840 and 840-1500 keV plus 20 keV-7 MeV spectra

BARREL Balloon 2X XRI (X-ray Instrument) sodium iodide scintillator spectrometer measuring bremsstrahlung X-ray spectra and flux from precipitating radiation-belt electrons; payload 2X of the BARREL 2013-2014 Antarctic campaign, with 10 keV-10 MeV response, 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV, plus 20 keV-7 MeV spectra in 48-channel/4 s and 256-channel/32 s products

BARREL Balloon 2Y XRI (X-ray Instrument) energetic-particle bremsstrahlung X-ray spectrometer measuring precipitating radiation-belt electron losses via 10 keV-10 MeV X-rays; payload 2Y of the second BARREL Antarctic campaign (2013-2014), with 50 ms bands at 10-180, 180-550, 550-840, and 840-1500 keV plus 20 keV-7 MeV spectra

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2P MAG (magnetometer) three-axis TCM2 tilt-compensated magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10-50 nT resolution for substorm and ULF wave context; payload 2P of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014)

BARREL Balloon 2Q MAG (Magnetometer) three-axis tilt-compensated magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10–50 nT resolution for substorm and ultra-low-frequency wave context; TCM2 sensor on payload 2Q of the second BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Antarctic campaign, 2013–2014

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2E MAG (Magnetometer) TCM2 tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring vector geomagnetic-field components at 1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution, used to identify substorms and ULF oscillations; payload 2E of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014)

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2Y MAG (Magnetometer), a TCM2 tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer on payload 2Y of the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014), measuring local vector magnetic field components at ~1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution for substorm and ULF magnetic-field context of X-ray precipitation observations

Cluster-Rumba FGM (Fluxgate Magnetometer) fluxgate magnetometer measuring the three-component DC magnetic field in Earth’s magnetosphere and solar wind; the Rumba/Cluster C1 unit uses dual triaxial boom sensors with selectable ±256 to ±65,500 nT ranges, normal cadence about 20 vectors/s, and burst/MSA high-rate sampling up to 124 vectors/s.

Cluster-Salsa FGM (Fluxgate Magnetometer) magnetometer measuring the three-component DC magnetic field vector and low-frequency magnetic fluctuations around the Cluster FM6 spacecraft; paired inboard/outboard triaxial fluxgate sensors provide ranges from about ±256 to ±65,500 nT with normal ~20 vectors/s and burst/MSA sampling up to ~124 vectors/s

BARREL Balloon 2D MAG (Magnetometer) tilt-compensated three-axis magnetometer measuring vector magnetic-field components for substorm and ULF-wave context at 1 s cadence with ~10 nT resolution; PNI TCM2 sensor on payload 2D of the second BARREL Antarctic balloon campaign, 2013-2014, conjugate with the Van Allen Probes

Communication/Navigation Outage Forecasting System (C/NOFS) PLP (Planar Langmuir Probe) dual-disk Langmuir probe measuring in situ topside/equatorial ionospheric plasma density, high-time-resolution density fluctuations and irregularities, low-rate background density for ionosphere models, and spacecraft surface potential during scintillation/outage studies

BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Storm Probes Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2E EPHM (Ephemeris) virtual platform/trajectory data product measuring balloon position versus time; provides payload 2E latitude, longitude, altitude and positions in multiple coordinate systems for the second Antarctic BARREL campaign (2013-2014), used to geolocate X-ray observations and magnetic conjugacy.
